title: Language profile
description: One of observations.json, decisions.json or external.json for a language and edition: what a drafting agent has to know, recorded with evidence. See README.md for the contract.

iso.description: ISO 639-3 code of the edition's language.

edition.description: Edition id (bcv-commons/bibles or lexeme-aligner id), or the draft project id when no published edition exists.

licence.description: SPDX-like licence of this file: CC0-1.0 for observations; the edition's licence for decisions; per entry for external.

ignore_marks.description: Combining marks the validator ignores when matching forms (e.g. tone marks).

ref.description: USFM book code, chapter:verse in the edition's numbering.

n.description: Occurrences of the form or pattern in the whole corpus (optional, given once per entry).

form.description: The exact form found in this verse, when it differs from value (inflection, tone).

source.description: term: Strong's number (H7458, G2316) or a gloss; formula: the source phrase (Hebrew/Greek or BSB wording); name: the source-language name.

external_source.description: external only: dataset and licence, e.g. 'gram-struct/external (WALS, CC-BY-4.0)'.

attested.description: term, formula, name: 'attested' = the value occurs as such in a cited verse; 'by-rule' = built by analogy from the cited models.

words.description: Words of the assisting translation (BSB) this entry answers, lower case: a tool that prepares a verse matches the entry by them, so the same word is never looked up twice.
